_note: Mechanism: misplaced confidence, pursued past the point any reasonable person would stop. The joke is that admitting the mistake becomes more expensive than the mistake.

premise.situation: A friend insists he knows a shortcut and refuses to turn on the sat nav
premise.turn: He drives forty minutes into farmland rather than admit the turning was wrong
premise.detail: he turns the radio down to concentrate on a road he has never seen

character_sheet: a man in his thirties, close-cropped beard, denim jacket, driving

beats.text: My friend Danny does not use sat nav. Danny knows a way.
Twenty minutes in, he turns the radio down. That is the tell.
The radio goes down when Danny stops recognising the road.
We passed a horse. Then we passed the same horse again.
I offered him my phone and he said, no, I can picture it.
We arrived fifty minutes late to a thing that lasted twenty.
He still says we saved time on the motorway.
